case: arrays of domains over text, numeric and timestamptz
contract: Domain-array result metadata retains each declared qualified domain array type while values decode as lossless PostgreSQL array text.
Text, high-precision numeric and two-distinct-instant timestamptz arrays preserve NULL elements through qualified text binding, with matching array_to_json and array_send oracles.
The native and bound comparisons run in an Asia/Kathmandu transaction session.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration domain_array_family_contract::value_contract_domain_arrays_over_text_numeric_and_timestamptz_use_base_types -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other PostgreSQL domain-array base types and session configurations remain open in B3.
